full_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver ONE square transparent PNG miniature token for Tales of Maj'Eyal: giant grey rat. Request 1024 x 1024 pixels; retain the tool's native resolution and alpha.

Identity brief: One large adult slate-grey rat with long pointed muzzle, rounded ears, four feet and one long bare tail. It runs in a very low, broad, elongated sideward crouch facing right; back and rump are one long horizontal mass, front feet visibly apart. Its open S-shaped tail separates from its body and curves into free dark disc space.
Family separation: Existing brown rat is compact warm-brown crouch with a tail arcing close around its back. White rat is tall raised ivory forebody. Grey rat must instead read as a medium-value cool-slate long horizontal profile with an open S tail, differing in silhouette and value from both. No coat-color-only distinction.
Composition: One complete rat on one disc with all paws, ears and entire tail inside the rim. Head lies away from upper-right UI margin. Leave a visible wedge of disc between tail and torso. Broad pale-facing planes on back and muzzle survive 48px reduction.

Match the designated style reference's steep overhead three-quarter camera, upper-left soft light, matte painted miniature finish and thin charcoal-brown physical disc with a restrained bronze-grey bevel. The disc occupies about 82% of the canvas width. All anatomy and equipment must remain inside it, with a clear margin. Use broad readable value planes and a crisp silhouette at 48/64/96px; dark bodies need a broad pale rim or lighter facing plane, not tiny glowing outlines. Keep identity-defining features out of the upper-right rank area and upper-left interaction-marker area. Native references establish identity; they do not override the style reference's camera or disc. Do not copy another species from a style reference.

Palette/material: Medium cool slate-grey fur, pale bone-grey broad plane highlights and warm taupe underside, pink-grey bare tail and feet. Dark eyes readable. No green poison cloud, blue ring, particle effect or text.
True transparent alpha outside the disc; no painted checkerboard. Keep the entire disc in frame and transparent corners. This is a static identity illustration. Add no faction ring, health arc, shield, rank, crown, UI marker, number, text, aura, scene or floor outside the disc. No recolor-only substitute for a different species, no montage and no alternate variants in one image. Anatomy must match the identity brief, including intentional missing limbs.

Reference roles:
Image 1: style — Use the approved high three-quarter overhead camera, matte sculpted fur, dark physical disc and muted copper-grey rim; do not copy its body or tail pose.
Image 2: identity — Native species and slate-grey coat only; ignore blue effects.
